tool.name: scrape_facebook_posts
tool.description: Facebook posts scraper for public pages and profiles: text, date, reactions by type, comments, shares, video views, pictures, video and link of every post, newest first. Up to 20 results per request, as JSON.

pages.title: Facebook pages
pages.description: Links of public pages or profiles (https://www.facebook.com/NASA), their names (NASA) or numeric ids. Several pages are read side by side. A page that Facebook shows only to logged-in users (age or country limits) is reported and costs nothing.

maxResults.title: Maximum posts per page
maxResults.description: Posts to save for each page, newest first. A request returns 20 rows at most.

postedAfter.title: Only posts since
postedAfter.description: Lower date limit: a day (YYYY-MM-DD) or a period back from now such as 3 days, 2 weeks or 6 months.

postedBefore.title: Only posts until
postedBefore.description: Upper date limit: a day (YYYY-MM-DD, included) or a period back from now. The read starts at that day instead of paging down to it, so a month from two years ago costs only that month.
